categories.combo.hybrid: Both powers at {{percent}}% of their duration
categories.intro: Every weapon belongs to a category. The categories of your equipped weapons decide your Special Power. Activate it with the power button or the {{hotkey}} key: while it is active, every weapon hit applies its effect. The {{cooldown}}s cooldown starts as soon as you activate it.
categories.power.bloodyHarvest: Steals {{amount}} HP for every enemy killed.
categories.power.plague: Poisons enemies for {{percent}}% of their max HP every {{tick}}s for {{duration}}s.
categories.scalesWithLevel: Power effects grow with your player level.
categories.title: Categories
competition.description1: Compete to collect the most XP relics each day. Only your highest score of the day counts, so keep improving your run and climb the leaderboard.
competition.description2: At the end of the event, the players with the highest daily score will be crowned the Color Festival Champions and claim the grand reward. Survive longer, defeat more enemies, and gather every XP Orb you can!
donationDescription: This minigame is created for the community. Donations are greatly appreciated!
endGameConfirmation: Are you sure you want to end the game early?
finalBossDescription: Defeat the final boss to open a hole where it fell. Get close to the hole and click it (tap on mobile) to end the game right away. Every second left on the timer adds {{points}} points to your score.
instructions1: Defeat the boss in each area to unlock the next one.
instructions2: Collect relics and gems dropped by enemies before they disappear to unlock weapons and perks.
instructions3: Equip up to 4 weapons per game. Combine weapons from the same category to unlock extra power.
instructions4: Click your Bumpkin avatar to view weapon and enemy stats. Equip or combine wearables before starting to gain extra boosts.
instructions6: For more details about each weapon, check the Weapon Guide in your Player Profile.
instructions7: Collect relics to gain XP and upgrade your weapons.
instructions8: Equip a passive ability wearable to increase orb magnet range.
intro.description1: Enter the Haunted World of Halloween!
intro.description2: Battle terrifying monsters, collect relics, unleash powerful weapons, and defeat deadly bosses to unlock new areas. Dare to face the horrors that await!
leaderboard.competitionNotStarted: The accumulate competition has not started yet. It will run from {{date}}.
leaderboard.validation.order: The start date cannot be after the end date. Min: {{min}}, Max: {{max}}.
leaderboard.validation.required: Select a start date and an end date. Min: {{min}}, Max: {{max}}.
noWearableBuffScoreBonus: Activate only equipment without buff wearables during the game to receive x{{multiplier}} on your XP Orb score at the end.
perk.description.cooldownReduction: Reduces secondary weapon cooldowns per level
perk.description.criticalChance: Chance to deal double damage per level
perk.description.healing: Regenerate HP every second, amount scales per level
perk.description.luck: Improves rare drop/chest odds per level
perk.description.pickupRadius: Increases item pickup/magnet radius per level
portal.missionObjectives: Collect the required amount of exp orbs to get event tokens! The more you earn, the more tokens you get!
retriesDescription: When your health runs out you can pay {{cost}} FLOWER to retry and keep fighting, but your score drops to {{percent}}% when you do. You can retry up to {{max}} times per game. Retries are not available in training.
reviveConfirmation: Are you sure you want to spend {{cost}} FLOWERs to retry?
reviveDescription: Spend FLOWERs to come back and keep fighting.
reviveScoreWarning: If you retry you will only keep {{percent}}% of your score
specialPower.label: {{categories}} {{percent}}%
weapon.description.frozenSkull: An orbiting frozen skull that circles your Bumpkin and hits nearby enemies.
weapon.description.flyStorm: Keeps a swarm of flies active. Each fly latches onto a nearby enemy and bites it over time, then seeks a new target when it dies.
weapon.description.bloodScythe: A bloody sweeping slash that automatically aims at the nearest enemy. Its arc widens with each level.
weapon.description.poisonVial: Throws a poison vial at the nearest enemy that shatters on impact.
weapon.description.crimsonVial: Binds a blood tether to the nearest enemies, making them bleed for as long as it lasts.
weapon.description.cursedCoffin: A cursed coffin drops onto the nearest enemy and bursts, launching shards in every direction.
weapon.description.frostChain: A frozen chain anchors to the nearest enemy, dealing damage in a small area around them and knocking them back. Secondary enemies hit take half damage.
weapon.description.mossGround: Spreads moss under enemies, dealing damage over time.
weapon.description.banishedJackOLantern: Rolls a banished Jack O'Lantern forward, piercing through multiple enemies.
weapon.description.frostFlower: Summons a frost flower that orbits you and shoots frost at enemies.
weapon.description.bloodKnife: Throws bloody knives that ricochet between nearby enemies.
weapon.description.darknessBook: Fires dark magic at the nearest enemy for steady ranged damage.
weapon.statDescription.arcDegrees: Attack arc covered by the weapon.
weapon.statDescription.areaRadius: Radius of the area affected by the weapon.
weapon.statDescription.bounceCount: How many times a projectile can bounce or chain.
weapon.statDescription.chainRadius: Distance used to find the next chained target.
weapon.statDescription.cooldownMs: Time between weapon activations. Lower is better.
weapon.statDescription.damage: Damage dealt by each hit or tick.
weapon.statDescription.dotDamage: Damage dealt on each damage-over-time tick.
weapon.statDescription.dotTickMs: Time between damage-over-time ticks. Lower is faster.
weapon.statDescription.durationMs: How long the weapon effect remains active.
weapon.statDescription.hitCooldownMs: Minimum time before the same target can be hit again. Lower is better.
weapon.statDescription.homingSpeed: How fast homing summons move toward enemies.
weapon.statDescription.knockback: Distance enemies are pushed back when hit.
weapon.statDescription.orbitRadius: Distance between the player and orbiting weapons.
weapon.statDescription.pierce: How many targets a projectile can pass through.
weapon.statDescription.projectileCount: Number of projectiles or summons created per activation.
weapon.statDescription.range: Maximum reach or travel distance of the weapon.
weapon.statDescription.size: Size multiplier applied to the weapon or projectile.
weapon.statDescription.statusDurationMs: How long the enemy remains affected by the status effect.
wouldYouLikeToUnlock: Would you like to buy more attempts?
youHaveRunOutOfAttempts: You have run out of attempts.
